lines.en: label kaorispringmorninggen:
scene kaorispringmorninggen
Despite how confusing it is simply being around her, I can always count on Kaori to never make me feel any {i}worse{/i} when I go to see her. So I guess that's a good thing.
lines.zh: 尽管光是待在她身边就已经够让人困惑的了，但我始终可以指望 Kaori 不会让我在见她之后感觉{i}更糟{/i}。所以我想这也算是件好事。

lines.en: if halloweenfive17 == False:
Of course, this also means that the likelihood of her making me any happier is just as likely as me having sex with her in the near future, so I'm kind of shit out of luck in that department too.
lines.zh: 当然，这也意味着她能让我变得更开心的可能性，跟我近期能跟她上床的可能性一样高，所以在这方面我也同样没戏。

lines.en: I guess there was that one time she almost raped me, though. So who knows? Maybe that will happen again and she'll be carrying my spawn before the next blue moon rises.
lines.zh: 不过以前倒是有过那么一次，她差点强暴了我。所以谁知道呢？也许这种事还会再来一次，在下一个蓝月亮升起之前她就怀上了我的种。

lines.en: else:
Maybe sometime in the future, I'll be able to visit her for more than just food though. Especially now that I know she has a taste for {i}me.{/i} So maybe I can be the one to feed her for once.
lines.zh: 不过也许将来的某一天，我去找她就不只是为了吃的了。尤其是现在我知道她对{i}我{/i}有胃口。所以也许这次可以换我来喂她。

lines.en: It beats giving her {i}kittens.{/i} At least in terms of the result. But hey, maybe being next to her would actually make me feel like a {i}good{/i} parent.
lines.zh: 这总比送她{i}小猫{/i}强。至少在结果上是。不过话说回来，也许待在她身边真的会让我觉得自己是个{i}好{/i}家长。

lines.en: Either way, I spend my morning at her newest job. Or at least what I assume is her newest job as I've yet to bump into her in an even more recent location.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我的早晨就花在她最新的工作地点上了。至少是我猜她最新的工作地点——因为我还没在更新的地方撞见过她。

lines.en: scene black
She creams me in front of a crowd of people who are also patiently waiting to be creamed. And I can't help but imagine that happening in the more visually appealing way. Just with roles reversed.
lines.zh: 她在一群同样耐心等着被“浇奶油”的人面前给我浇了奶油。我忍不住想象这一幕以更好看的方式发生——只是角色互换一下。

lines.en: Basically, I imagine her getting gangbanged by a group of random passersby and all of the ridiculous things she'd likely say in her fit of expected ecstasy.
lines.zh: 基本上，我在想象她被一群路过的陌生人轮奸，以及在预料之中的狂喜里她大概会说出哪些荒唐的话。

lines.en: Kaori notices a sudden increase in my body temperature and asks me if it's mating season. I tell her it is and that I'm looking for a mate.
lines.zh: Kaori 察觉到我的体温突然升高，问我是不是到了交配的季节。我说是，而且我正在找配偶。

lines.en: She blushes and runs away. I must not have used the proper mating dance.
lines.zh: 她脸红了，跑开了。看来我用的求偶舞不太对。

lines.en: Eventually, I pay my bill and jerk off in a nearby public restroom while a spider sits on my thigh and watches.
lines.zh: 最后我付了账单，在附近的公共洗手间里打了一发，一只蜘蛛趴在我大腿上看着。

lines.en: I hope it lays its eggs inside of me. That way, it will be egg time forever.
lines.zh: 我希望它把卵产在我的体内。那样的话，就永远是卵的时间了。
